steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Hajj is the fifth Pillar of Islam — every Muslim who is physically and financially able must make the pilgrimage to Makkah at least once in their lifetime. Over 2 million Muslims perform Hajj each year during the month of Dhul-Hijjah. | RS Exam Tips — Hajj: Pilgrimage: 1. For Hajj: Pilgrimage questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
